function.name: impl_from_ILockBytes
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface from which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: FileLockBytesImpl * - a pointer to the containing record.

function.name: GetProtectMode
function.description: This function determines the protection mode based on the openFlags parameter. It uses the STGM_ACCESS_MODE macro to check the access mode of the openFlags. If the access mode is STGM_WRITE or STGM_READWRITE, it returns PAGE_READWRITE. Otherwise, it returns PAGE_READONLY.

parameters.name: openFlags
parameters.description: This parameter represents the flags for opening a file or device. It is used to determine the protection mode.

function.return_type: DWORD. It represents the protection mode. It can be either PAGE_READWRITE or PAGE_READONLY.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_Construct
function.description: This function constructs a FileLockBytesImpl object, sets its properties, and returns a pointer to its ILockBytes interface.

parameters.name: hFile
parameters.description: Handle to the file to be locked

parameters.name: openFlags
parameters.description: Flags that control the behavior of the function

parameters.name: pwcsName
parameters.description: Pointer to a wide-character string that specifies the name of the file

parameters.name: pLockBytes
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an ILockBytes interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK on success, E_FAIL if the file handle is invalid, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the function fails to allocate memory.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_ILockBytes. If it does, it assigns the interface to the output parameter and increases its reference count. If it doesn't, it sets the output parameter to NULL and returns an error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: An interface pointer that the function will attempt to query.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The interface ID that the function will check against.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: An output parameter that will either receive the interface pointer or NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and E_NOINTERFACE if the interface ID does not match.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the FileLockBytesImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an ILockBytes interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases a file lock and frees up associated resources when the reference count drops to zero.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an ILockBytes interface that represents the file lock to be released.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement operation.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_ReadAt
function.description: This function reads a specified number of bytes from a specified location in an ILockBytes object into memory, starting at the current seek pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the ILockBytes interface

parameters.name: ulOffset
parameters.description: The offset at which to start reading

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer into which the data is read

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The number of bytes to read

parameters.name: pcbRead
parameters.description: Pointer to location that contains actual number of bytes read

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if successful, STG_E_READFAULT if there was an error reading from the file, E_FAIL if the environment is not sane

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_WriteAt
function.description: This function writes a specified number of bytes at a specified offset into the underlying file or byte array from the provided buffer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the ILockBytes interface

parameters.name: ulOffset
parameters.description: Offset at which to start writing

parameters.name: pv
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer from which to write data

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: Number of bytes to write

parameters.name: pcbWritten
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable where the number of bytes written will be stored

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, STG_E_ACCESSDENIED if the protection is not PAGE_READWRITE, STG_E_WRITEFAULT if the writing operation fails, and E_FAIL if the environment is not sane.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_Flush
function.description: This function returns S_OK indicating the operation was successful.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an ILockBytes interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation, S_OK if successful

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_SetSize
function.description: This function sets the size of a file in bytes.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface used to access the file

parameters.name: newSize
parameters.description: The new size for the file

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: get_lock_error
function.description: This function checks the last error occurred and returns a corresponding HRESULT error code.
function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the error code corresponding to the last error occurred

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_LockRegion
function.description: This function locks a specified region in a byte array object that supports the ILockBytes interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the ILockBytes interface

parameters.name: libOffset
parameters.description: The offset at which to start the lock

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: The length of the region to lock

parameters.name: dwLockType
parameters.description: The type of lock to apply

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, STG_E_INVALIDFUNCTION if the lock type is LOCK_WRITE, or the error code from get_lock_error() if the LockFileEx function fails.

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_UnlockRegion
function.description: This function unlocks a region in a file that was previously locked.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the locked bytes

parameters.name: libOffset
parameters.description: Offset at which to start unlocking

parameters.name: cb
parameters.description: Number of bytes to unlock

parameters.name: dwLockType
parameters.description: Type of lock to unlock

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful, STG_E_INVALIDFUNCTION if the lock type is invalid, or an error code if the operation failed

function.name: FileLockBytesImpl_Stat
function.description: This function is used to retrieve the STATSTG structure for the ILockBytes interface. It also sets the name, type, size, and lock support fields of the STATSTG structure.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an ILockBytes interface

parameters.name: pstatstg
parameters.description: Pointer to a STATSTG structure

parameters.name: grfStatFlag
parameters.description: Flag that specifies whether the pwcsName member of the STATSTG structure is returned

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the function succeeds.
